articles.title: India likely to meet FY27 fiscal deficit target despite spending pressures: Goldman Sachs
articles.desc: The Centre appears on track to meet the fiscal deficit target set for FY27. Strong corporate tax collections are offsetting some revenue pressures observed in the first half of the fiscal year. The government's fiscal position improved significantly in September compared to August, aided by higher direct tax revenues. Focused expenditure reallocation will be crucial in achieving the deficit goals.

articles.title: India’s consumers are back, its stocks aren’t: Srinivasan Sivabalan
articles.desc: Amid the vibrant festive season in India, consumer demand is soaring, prompting businesses to boost sales and raise prices accordingly. However, rising costs are pressuring profit margins, causing a decline in investor confidence. The stock market struggles to reflect the upbeat consumer activity, signaling a potential need for a resolution to the Iran war and governmental intervention to promote stability.

Positive Breakout: These 6 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
articles.desc: As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

articles.title: Oil Price Today (November 2): Crude oil falls to $111 as Iran-Qatar talks continue to end war. What are experts saying?
articles.desc: Crude oil price : Oil prices have plummeted dramatically, impacting Brent and WTI crude significantly. As Iranian and Qatari officials engage in talks to mitigate tensions from the US-Israeli conflict regarding Iran, the situation is further aggravated by security threats and oil tanker assaults in the Strait of Hormuz. Experts warn of ongoing price instability post-US midterm elections, creating an unpredictable environment for global energy supply chains and market responses.

articles.title: Indian stocks may recover on steady growth and earnings, Axis AMC says
articles.desc: Indian stocks are expected to recover in the financial year due to strong earnings and economic growth. The Nifty 50 index has decreased significantly after years of gains, partly due to global issues. The fund manager emphasizes that foreign fund outflows do not indicate a decline in India's growth prospects. Certain sectors like AI, energy, and domestic manufacturing are highlighted for potential investment.

articles.title: Gold lingers near one-year low as Fed hike expectations firm
articles.desc: Gold prices experienced a minor uptick in early trading across Asia; however, they linger near a one-year low. Persistent worries about inflation are bolstering expectations for an impending Federal Reserve rate increase this year. The recent drop in tech stocks has placed additional strain on bullion prices, prompting a sell-off in safe-haven investments. Buyers in major Asian markets, especially India and China, remain hesitant amid expectations of further price declines.

articles.title: Dollar rangebound ahead of US midterms; bitcoin reels from crypto heist
articles.desc: Major currencies remained steady as traders evaluated the upcoming US midterm elections and significant economic data. Bitcoin and Ether experienced losses after a major security breach at Binance, raising investor concerns. The euro hovered near a 17-month low following Fitch's revision of France's outlook to negative. Hedge funds reportedly faced significant losses that could limit market reactions to election results.

articles.title: Oil slips more than 1% as talks continue on ending Iran war
articles.desc: Oil prices witnessed a decline of more than 1% as Iranian and Qatari diplomats engaged in discussions regarding the US-Israeli conflict. Brent crude futures fell to $111.84 per barrel, alongside a drop in US West Texas Intermediate crude. Analysts express optimism about potential advancements in these negotiations, which have eased short-term pricing worries.

articles.title: The Papers: 'A family's pain' and 'EU students in return for trade'
articles.desc: The parents of Henry Nowak speaking for the first time about the moment they learnt he had been murdered leads Monday's Daily Mirror.

articles.title: Fintechs fortify cyber defences; Logistics cos in the speed lane
articles.desc: Happy Monday! Fintechs are stepping up security as AI-powered cyberattacks become more sophisticated. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: Stock Market Live Updates: Sensex surges over 700 points in pre-opening session, Nifty above 23,200
Crypto Heist: Binance covers 95% tokens, resumes withdrawals
articles.desc: Binance has officially restarted withdrawals for select cryptocurrencies such as bitcoin and ether, following successful recovery of a substantial amount of stolen funds linked to a massive North Korean heist. Notably, last year saw $2.9 billion in cryptocurrency stolen through multiple incidents. The crypto exchange intends to further restore withdrawal capabilities for more assets in subsequent phases.

articles.title: Sun Pharma’s specialty portfolio, Organon deal to drive growth
articles.desc: Sun Pharmaceutical achieved notable revenue growth in the September quarter, driven by strong performance in India and specialty medicines. The company anticipates medium-term growth from therapies like Ilumya and ongoing innovative projects. Although profitability was affected by acquisition and litigation costs, the domestic market share increased to 8.6% from last year. R&D investments are expected to rise in the second half of FY27 as development accelerates.

articles.title: Reliance Industries eyes growth boost from O2C, retail and Jio businesses
articles.desc: Reliance Industries has reported a significant growth in revenue and profits for the September quarter. The oil-to-chemicals segment has led this growth while retail segment profitability faced pressures from digital commerce investments. Jio Platforms also reported double digit revenue and profit growth, aided by increased average revenue per user and subscriber additions. Rising inflation and a shift in festive demand to the December quarter may impact future retail earnings.

articles.title: November could favour bulls, but macro headwinds cloud outlook
articles.desc: In November, investors are optimistic about Indian equities due to ongoing festive celebrations and better-than-expected corporate earnings. While the Sensex and Nifty boasted gains in October, other market indices saw declines. However, potential threats such as rising crude oil prices and global uncertainties remain. A noticeable surge in purchases by foreign portfolio investors signals renewed interest in Indian stocks.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian shares bend under AI stress; Apple earnings loom
articles.desc: Concerns about negative cash flow and the sheer scale of AI capex saw the cost of insuring against corporate defaults blow out last week, while gold hit a one-year low amid talk stressed investors were selling to raise money for margin calls.

articles.title: FPI G-Sec outflows nearly halve to Rs 5,400 crore in October
articles.desc: Foreign portfolio investors reduced their selling of Indian government securities and equities in October compared to September. Despite this, high oil prices and global yields pose challenges for sustained portfolio inflows. Economists caution that the slowdown may not indicate a definitive change in foreign investment trends. Political dynamics in other emerging markets might influence foreign capital movement toward India.

articles.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Platforms, M&M, CDSL, ITC, NTPC, IOCL and Hero MotoCorp
articles.desc: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher on Friday, with significant gains recorded in the Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex. Several major companies, including Reliance Industries and Jio Platforms, published positive quarterly earnings results. Reliance Industries saw a 41% increase in net profit, supported by strong performances in various sectors. Other companies like Sun Pharma and Indian Oil Corporation also reported significant changes in their net profits.

articles.title: D-Street poised for a positive start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
articles.desc: Benchmark indices demonstrated remarkable strength, finishing above key thresholds due to robust demand for large-cap equities. However, surging Brent crude oil prices are still triggering concerns relating to the macroeconomic environment among investors. The India VIX index has recorded a slight increase in market anxiety, signaling cautious attitudes from investors.

articles.title: FPI buying returns to Dalal Street as global investors rethink AI bets
articles.desc: Foreign portfolio investors have shifted from aggressive selling to net buying of Indian equities recently. They invested nearly $1.2 billion over the last ten trading sessions, particularly in large-cap stocks. This change in behavior may be attributed to concerns regarding the artificial intelligence trade influencing investor decisions. Globally, markets saw corrections, while Indian indices had a mixed performance in October.

articles.title: Nifty’s next move hinges on breakout above 23,200: Analysts
articles.desc: Nifty has recently surged by nearly 2%, approaching the resistance level at 23,200. Analysts recommend building long positions to capitalize on a potential breakout. Support is set between 22,600 and 22,800, serving as a buffer. Recommended stocks for investment this week include DLF and Zensar Technologies. Investors should exercise caution in the broader market until significant resistance levels are broken.

articles.title: GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October as festive demand beats high inflation and interest rates
articles.desc: India's GST collections in October reached ₹2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a 22.9% year-on-year increase. Strong consumption trends are indicated by rising passenger car sales and record digital payments. Power consumption also surged nearly 22% compared to last year, further emphasizing economic strength. Despite a high inflation rate of 5.5%, demand has remained robust, supporting growth forecasts. Analysts suggest this growth aligns with leading indicators of a consumption-driven economy.

articles.title: Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump again says conflict to end soon
articles.desc: US president warns Iran to make a deal, as IRGC says two tankers have hit mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: UN warns of security risks in Western Sahara as peacekeeping mission ends
articles.desc: The mission, known as MINURSO, has been in place in the disputed region since a ceasefire in 1991.

articles.title: Kherson braces for return of war as localised Russia-Ukraine truce ends
articles.desc: Moscow and Kyiv continue strikes elsewhere, but no reported violations in Kherson region during the six-day ceasefire.

articles.title: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
articles.desc: A rare humanitarian ceasefire allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.

articles.title: Thousands displaced from Hebron as Israel carries on siege
articles.desc: Almost 5,000 people have been displaced as a result of Israel’s military siege on the city of Hebron in the West Bank.

articles.title: Carney signals progress on Canada-US trade deal talks as midterms loom
articles.desc: Canadian PM Mark Carney announces progress in Canada-US trade deal talks ahead of Tuesday's US midterm elections.

articles.title: One nation, many opportunities: Why India's many elections may be keeping protests peaceful
articles.desc: People across India are protesting peacefully, contrasting with violent agitations seen in other countries. The 'one nation, multiple elections' framework allows diverse political benefits to be shared among parties. This electoral model keeps governments accountable and responsive to public needs. Elections help to channel frustrations and enable citizens to express their concerns. As a result, the political landscape remains dynamic and participatory, fostering a sense of empowerment.

articles.title: PM Modi to meet Niti Aayog leadership on Nov 5; likely to  review  work as govt begins shaping  FY28 Budget
articles.desc: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to meet the new leadership of Niti Aayog on November 5. This meeting aims to establish budget priorities amidst global uncertainty and economic growth challenges. The focus will be on enhancing domestic manufacturing and creating employment opportunities. Experts from various sectors will provide insights related to India's development objectives.

articles.title: CII calls for GST-like reforms in land, labour & local approvals
articles.desc: CII has called for extending the GST Council's approach to decriminalise offences in various sectors. This move aims to enhance ease of doing business and attract investments in land, labour, and construction. The organisation emphasizes the importance of simplifying regulatory processes across different government tiers.

articles.title: How will the Iran war shape the outcome of the US midterm vote?
articles.desc: The conflict has become a central issue ahead of Tuesday's polls.

articles.title: Reliance Retail says profit margins will improve from next year as its online business investments pay off
articles.desc: With ongoing investments in ecommerce, Reliance Retail expects better Ebitda margins. The company is enhancing dark stores to ensure quicker delivery times and adapting retail spaces to cater to online shoppers. Although recent reports indicate a decrease in net profit, digital commerce still surged by 42%. Jeyandran Venugopal, the chief executive, expresses assurance in maximizing current assets for growth while steering clear of extravagant competitor expenditures.

articles.title: Irdai to weigh 650+ responses on insurance commissions
articles.desc: The regulator had extended the deadline earlier by a week after receiving more than 650 responses to its September 23 consultation paper, which proposes tighter commission limits, changes to expense-of-management rules and a new distribution architecture. The industry is now awaiting the draft guidelines followed by the final framework.

articles.title: Banks are safe; AI bubble is the risk for global markets: Julius Baer CEO Stefan Bollinger
articles.desc: Stefan Bollinger highlights the potential risk of an AI bubble affecting global markets significantly. He notes that India's equity valuation correction is healthy, maintaining the country's growth story. Investors are increasingly diversifying their portfolios with a focus on hedge funds and private equity. The Fed's decision on rates remains uncertain, though high inflation complicates matters. Rising yields in Japan are likely to attract domestic investors back to their markets.

articles.title: Banks seek microloan guarantee extension
articles.desc: IDFC First Bank and small finance banks such as AU, Jana and Suryoday were among the biggest users of the scheme to reduce credit risk. They have set aside the guarantee fee for the current fiscal year, expecting the government to reopen the window soon, people aware of the matter said.

articles.title: Banks report 10-50% gains in productivity, turnaround time and costs from AI-led initiatives
articles.desc: Several banks in India have implemented artificial intelligence initiatives that have increased productivity and efficiency significantly. Notably, Kotak Mahindra Bank has improved its handling of corporate servicing volumes by 20-30% with the same workforce. Axis Bank's AI solutions are enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency across its operations. HDFC Bank has reported a reduction in service delivery turnaround times by 30%, reflecting the impact of digitization.

articles.title: Cyberattacks on banks, including AU Small Finance Bank, worry insurers as claim risks rise
articles.desc: Cyberattacks targeting financial institutions have raised concerns about security vulnerabilities and potential losses. AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a possible data breach involving customer information stored on Salesforce. Insurers have recently reported an increase in cyber incidents affecting banks and manufacturers over the past few months. The extent of these breaches and the impacted customer count are still under investigation.

articles.title: HomePod Mini 2 first look: Three things I love and one disappointment
articles.desc: When I first heard about the new $149 HomePod Mini 2 at Apple's Welcome Home event last month, I was disappointed. It's been six years since Apple launched its entry-level smart speaker, and all it got in the second gen was a chip bump, some color glowy stuff, and better AirPlay? For $50 more than […]

articles.title: Sebi to delist penny stocks: Market regulator plans AI-based surveillance of such firms
articles.desc: The Securities and Exchange Board of India plans to delist companies that have no economic activity. This move aims to protect investors, especially those investing in penny stocks. The regulator highlights the potential dangers posed by such inactive companies in the market. Additionally, Sebi intends to announce compliance requirements for foreign institutional investors soon.

articles.title: Mansukh Mandaviya rolls out EPFO services on WhatsApp, starts auto-settlement of small inoperative accounts
articles.desc: Union Labour & Employment Minister Mansukh Mandaviya launched EPFO services through WhatsApp for easier access. Subscribers can check their PF balance and transaction history conveniently using this platform. The automatic settlement for inoperative EPF accounts was also introduced, streamlining the process for beneficiaries. In total, around one lakh accounts will benefit from this initiative. The EPFO's commitment to evolve and focus on worker-centric innovations was emphasized during the celebration.

articles.title: EAM Jaishankar discusses Ukraine-Russia conflict solutions amid G20 summit
articles.desc: India has engaged in discussions with Russia, Europe, and Ukraine regarding the ongoing conflict and its impact. These talks focused on preventing attacks on civilian shipping and restoring grain exports affected by Black Sea disruptions. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar emphasised the complexity of discussions around ceasing attacks on energy installations. Various interpretations of what constitutes energy installations have complicated these discussions.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
articles.desc: Sensex and Nifty ended the week up about 0.5%, supported by resilient large-cap, IT and healthcare stocks. However, midcap and smallcap indices fell as much as 2% amid rising crude oil prices, inflation concerns and a global technology sell-off.

articles.title: Kashmiri apple supplies fall short of Diwali demand amid fungal outbreak
articles.desc: Supply of Kashmiri apples is currently inadequate due to a significant scab outbreak that has affected this year's crop. The primary concern is that a large percentage of apples arriving in markets are of lower grades. Growers are facing high production costs while receiving low returns on affected apples. Demand remains good ahead of Diwali, with higher-quality apples commanding good prices.

articles.title: Good intentions, unintended consequences: The cost of regulation
articles.desc: Regulation is vital for protecting consumers and building trust, but unpredictable or poorly calibrated policy changes can disrupt business economics, valuations and investment.

articles.title: Global beverage majors advance India IPO plans, from DRHP filing to board approval
articles.desc: Carlsberg has filed an updated draft red herring prospectus for its potential IPO in India. Pernod Ricard continues to prepare for its proposed listing while awaiting board approval for its Indian business. Coca-Cola is exploring a potential IPO for its Indian bottling operations, emphasizing the value in the domestic market. These developments indicate a growing interest in public listings among multinational beverage companies in India.

articles.title: 10 penny stocks plunge up to 70% in three months. Do you own any?
articles.desc: Ten actively traded penny stocks have fallen between 34% and 73% over the past three months, highlighting the risks associated with low-priced shares. Cropster Agro recorded the steepest decline at 73%, followed by Bridge Securities and Empower India, which dropped 55% and 50%, respectively.

articles.title: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough'
articles.desc: Families in the West Midlands say they are worried about paying winter energy bills.

articles.title: Festive spending drives record UPI transactions in October
articles.desc: UPI processed transactions worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore during the month, a 16% rise from a year earlier and the highest on record, signalling that the platform continues to expand even as consumers navigate higher prices of electronics and other festive purchases this year.

articles.title: India's October Gross GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore
articles.desc: India's gross GST collection reached Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October, representing a 22.9% increase from last year. The gross GST collected for the April-October period totaled Rs 14.78 lakh crore, showing a 13.2% growth year-on-year. Maharashtra recorded the highest revenue for October at Rs 35,150 crore, followed by Karnataka and Gujarat. Some states, including Sikkim and Ladakh, experienced significant declines in GST collections during the month.

articles.title: IOC, BPCL, HPCL clock Rs 30,106 cr Q2 profit, nearly 39 pc of last year's annual earnings
articles.desc: In the third quarter, spanning July to September, India's three major state-run fuel retailers announced a combined net profit of Rs 30,106 crore, reversing a previous loss of Rs 18,150 crore. This profitability surge defied the ongoing freeze on petrol and diesel prices since May. Indian Oil Corporation achieved its highest standalone quarterly net profit, buoyed by strong refining margins, yet faces ongoing challenges related to fuel under-recoveries.

articles.title: Can Nifty, Sensex extend gains after rallying up to 2% last week? 4 factors to watch on Monday
articles.desc: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended the week higher, gaining up to 0.5%, even as broader markets declined amid rising crude oil prices above $117 a barrel. Investors will track oil price movements, foreign institutional investor (FII) activity, global cues and domestic market trends for direction. FIIs turned net buyers after a 10-week selling streak, lending support to sentiment.

articles.title: FPIs pull out Rs 34,843 cr from equities in Oct; turn net buyers last week
articles.desc: Amidst rising economic fears, foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October. Although they had made significant contributions in July and August, outflows continued through September. By late October, a turnaround occurred as foreign investors became net buyers, infusing approximately Rs 6,300 crore into the market. Support from domestic institutional investors provided much-needed stability as all eyes turn to potential global impacts on investor sentiment.

articles.title: Fuel, forex and farmers: Why India is betting big on maize
articles.desc: A grain that once fed chickens now fuels cars and, soon, planes. The harder question is whether Indian farms can keep up with the demand it has created.

articles.title: ITC Q2 Results Preview: Profit seen falling nearly 30% YoY as cigarette tax hikes bite
articles.desc: ITC is expected to report a weak Q2, with brokerages forecasting an 8% decline in cigarette volumes and a drop of up to 29% in cigarette operating profit following tax hikes. Nuvama expects consolidated revenue to fall 3% YoY and EBITDA to decline 20%. Growth in FMCG and paper businesses could provide some support against the pressure.

articles.title: Nifty IT’s 18% rally may mark a durable leadership cycle; 35,000 next: LKP's Vatsal Bhuva
articles.desc: Nifty IT’s 18% October rally could signal a sustained leadership cycle, supported by improving momentum, a bullish RSI crossover and capital rotation from global AI stocks. Analyst Vatsal Bhuva sees the index targeting 35,000. He remains cautious on Swiggy, bullish on Acutaas Chemicals, and recommends buying Persistent Systems and Eternal based on positive technical setups.

articles.title: IPO Calendar: Primary market cools after Jio frenzy, but 13 listings lined up
articles.desc: India’s IPO market is set for a quiet week, with just one fresh issue worth Rs 56.68 crore opening for subscription and no mainboard launches. Vedant Poly Fabs will be the only new IPO, while 13 companies are expected to list. The slowdown follows October’s blockbuster Rs 30,188 crore Jio Platforms IPO, which was subscribed over 22 times.

articles.title: Bonus issues, stock splits, dividends: Infosys, Asian Paints among over 40 stocks turning ex-date this week
articles.desc: More than 40 companies have scheduled record dates for dividends, bonus issues, rights issues and stock splits during November 2–6, 2026. Major names include Infosys, Asian Paints, Coal India, Power Grid and Info Edge, while Sanofi India will offer the week’s highest announced dividend of Rs 75 per share.

articles.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering bulk of $6 billion in stolen funds
articles.desc: Binance has announced the resumption of cryptocurrency withdrawals after recovering a significant portion of stolen assets. The exchange has identified a North Korean unit behind the theft and is actively working to recover remaining tokens. Law enforcement agencies are tracking the laundering of stolen assets into cryptocurrencies. Binance has committed to covering the financial losses incurred due to the hack.
